title: The Three Thrones
summary: In the cosmic depths beyond known space, the Three Primordial Demon Thrones awaken, refusing to acknowledge a mortal human as Sovereign and declaring total eradication war on Earth.

panels.shot: infinite cosmic void of black glass and dead stars wide shot
panels.action: A silent abyss at the edge of the universe: floating shattered planets surrounded by red anti-matter nebulas.
panels.prose_en: A silent abyss at the edge of the universe: floating shattered planets surrounded by red anti-matter nebulas.
panels.prose_hi: Brahmand ke kinare par ek mook rasatal: tairte hue toote hue grah, jo lal padarth-virodhi neeharikaon se ghire hue han.

panels.shot: three colossal 500-foot obsidian thrones hovering in triangle formation
panels.action: Three titanic thrones carved from the calcified bones of dead gods form a silent, menacing triangle.
panels.prose_en: Three titanic thrones carved from the calcified bones of dead gods form a silent, menacing triangle.
panels.prose_hi: Mrit devtaon ki calsified haddiyon se bane teen titanic sinhasan ek muk, khatarnak trikon banate han.

panels.shot: left throne: lord baal-zahar, sovereign of blood and rot
panels.action: Seated on the left: Lord Baal-Zahar—a 20-foot horned demon titan wrapped in cloaks of boiling crimson blood.

dialogue.speaker: baal_zahar
dialogue.text: The mortal child has claimed the Crown. The ancient covenant stirs.

panels.prose_en: Seated on the left: Lord Baal-Zahar—a 20-foot horned demon titan wrapped in cloaks of boiling crimson blood.
panels.prose_hi: Bain or baithe han: bhagwan bal-zhar - ubalte lal rakt ke labade mein lipta hua ek 20 foot ka seeng wala danav titan.

panels.shot: right throne: empress lilith-morg, sovereign of souls
panels.action: Seated on the right: Empress Lilith-Morg—an ethereal wraith queen draped in spectral green soul-fire and weeping masks.

dialogue.speaker: lilith_morg
dialogue.text: A human vessel holding Asmodaius's crown? An insult to the primordial bloodline.

panels.prose_en: Seated on the right: Empress Lilith-Morg—an ethereal wraith queen draped in spectral green soul-fire and weeping masks.
panels.prose_hi: Daahini or baithi han: maharani lilith-morg - ek alaukik rani, ​​jo varnakramiy hare rang ki aatma-agni aur rote hue mukhauton mein lipati hui hai.

panels.shot: center throne: emperor nihilux, sovereign of the absolute void
panels.action: On the colossal center throne sits Emperor Nihilux—a faceless titan clad in star-eating black armor, eyes burning with green quasars.

dialogue.speaker: nihilux
dialogue.text: Earth has enjoyed its peaceful dawn for long enough. We shall purge the false heir.

panels.prose_en: On the colossal center throne sits Emperor Nihilux—a faceless titan clad in star-eating black armor, eyes burning with green quasars.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal kendra sinhasan par samrat nihilax baitha hai - ek chehrahin titan, jo taare khane wala kala kavach pahane hue hai, uski aankhen hare quasar se jal rahi han.

panels.shot: nihilux raising his four-pronged sceptre of void decay
panels.action: Nihilux raises an obsidian sceptre crowned with a dying pulsar; dark lightning arcs between the three thrones.

dialogue.speaker: nihilux
dialogue.text: AWAKEN THE ABYSSAL ARMADA!! MARCH UPON EARTH!!

panels.prose_en: Nihilux raises an obsidian sceptre crowned with a dying pulsar; dark lightning arcs between the three thrones.
panels.prose_hi: Nihilax ek marte hue pulsar se susajjit ek obsidian rajdand uthata hai; teen sinhasanon ke beech kali bijli chamakti hai.

panels.shot: millions of demonic dreadnoughts uncloaking in the void
panels.action: Across ten thousand light-years, a million pitch-black gothic dreadnoughts uncloak, their red plasma engines igniting.
panels.prose_en: Across ten thousand light-years, a million pitch-black gothic dreadnoughts uncloak, their red plasma engines igniting.
panels.prose_hi: Das hazar prakash-varsh ke par, ek lakh pich-kale gothic khunkhar kapde utaarte han, unke lal plasma engine prajvalit hote han.

panels.shot: earth seen from deep space: peaceful blue marble unaware
panels.action: Earth turns peacefully in space, continents glowing with morning sunlight, completely unaware of the approaching armada.
panels.prose_en: Earth turns peacefully in space, continents glowing with morning sunlight, completely unaware of the approaching armada.
panels.prose_hi: Prithvi shanti se antriksh mein ghum rahi hai, mahadweep subah ki dhoop se chamak rahe han, nikat aane wale armada se puri tarah anjaan han.

panels.shot: sudden dimensional shockwave rattling earth's orbital satellites
panels.action: An orbital defense satellite spins out of control as a gravitational shockwave ripples through the space-time fabric.
panels.prose_en: An orbital defense satellite spins out of control as a gravitational shockwave ripples through the space-time fabric.
panels.prose_hi: Ek kakshiy raksha upgrah antriksh-samay ke kapde ke madhyam se gurutvakarshan shockwev tarang ke roop mein niyantran se bahar ho jata hai.

panels.shot: inside section 9 command headquarters in seoul: sirens wailing
panels.action: Emergency red alarms bathe the giant subterranean operations floor; dozens of radar operators shout into headsets.

dialogue.speaker: radar_operator
dialogue.text: Massive gravitational anomalies in Sector 4! Spatial fabric is tearing open across the entire globe!

panels.prose_en: Emergency red alarms bathe the giant subterranean operations floor; dozens of radar operators shout into headsets.
panels.prose_hi: Aapatkalin lal alarm vishal bhumigat parichalan manjil ko nahate han; darjanon radar operator headset mein chillate han.

panels.shot: captain baek slamming both hands onto the holographic strategy table
panels.action: Supreme General Baek stares in horror at the global map: red breach markers appear over every major city on Earth.

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: This isn't an incursion... This is a full-scale planetary invasion!

panels.prose_en: Supreme General Baek stares in horror at the global map: red breach markers appear over every major city on Earth.
panels.prose_hi: Suprim general bake vaishvik manchitra ko darawani drishti se dekh rahe han: prithvi ke har pramukh shahar par lal ullanghan chinh dikhai dete han.

panels.shot: kang tae-jun stepping into the command room in full armor
panels.action: Tae-Jun enters, his Guardian Claymore strapped to his back, eyes burning with bronze tactical determination.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Baek. Activate all orbital defense grids. I'm going to the upper atmosphere.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun enters, his Guardian Claymore strapped to his back, eyes burning with bronze tactical determination.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun pravesh karta hai, uska abhibhavak clamor uski peeth par bandha hua hai, uski aankhen kansya samrik dridh sankalp se jal rahi han.

panels.shot: baek looking at tae-jun: 'where is ha-jun?!'
panels.action: Baek asks: 'Where is the Sovereign?!'

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun, where is your brother?! We need his domain!

panels.prose_en: Baek asks: 'Where is the Sovereign?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Bak puchta hai: 'samprabhu kahan hai?!'.

panels.shot: tae-jun looking out the bunker blast window toward saint mirren
panels.action: Tae-Jun looks toward Mapo district: 'He's at the university taking his morning exam. Let him finish his paper.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: He's taking his calculus exam. I will buy him thirty minutes.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun looks toward Mapo district: 'He's at the university taking his morning exam. Let him finish his paper.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun mapo jile ki or dekhta hai: 'vah vishwavidyalaya mein apni subah ki pariksha de raha hai. use apna paper pura karne do.'

panels.shot: inside saint mirren classroom: peaceful silence with clock ticking
panels.action: Sunlight streams through the high classroom windows; Ha-Jun sits at his desk, pencil scratching on math paper.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Integration by parts... Let u = x, dv = e^(2x) dx...

panels.prose_en: Sunlight streams through the high classroom windows; Ha-Jun sits at his desk, pencil scratching on math paper.
panels.prose_hi: Unchi kaksha ki khidkiyon se surya ka prakash pravahit hota hai; ha-jun apni mej par baitha hai, ganit ke kagaj par pencil se kharonch raha hai.

panels.shot: min-jae sitting two desks over sweating profusely over his exam
panels.action: Min-Jae bites his pencil eraser, sweating nervously as he glares at problem 4.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Why did I choose advanced calculus?! I should have studied with Ha-Jun!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae bites his pencil eraser, sweating nervously as he glares at problem 4.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je apne pencil eraser ko kaatata hai, samasya 4 ko dekhte hue ghabrahat ke saath pasina bahata hai.

panels.shot: kuro sitting on the classroom window ledge napping in the sun
panels.action: Little Kuro sits on the sunny sill, his head tucked under his wing, sleeping peacefully.
panels.prose_en: Little Kuro sits on the sunny sill, his head tucked under his wing, sleeping peacefully.
panels.prose_hi: Chhota kuro dhoop wali dehli par baitha hai, uska sir uske pankhon ke neeche chhipa hua hai, aur shanti se so raha hai.

panels.shot: kuro ruby eyes suddenly snapping wide open with shock
panels.action: Kuro's head snaps up; his ruby eyes widen in horror as his feathers bristle like needles.
panels.prose_en: Kuro's head snaps up; his ruby eyes widen in horror as his feathers bristle like needles.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ka sir fat gaya; uski lal aankhen bhay se fail jaati hain aur uske pankh suiyon ki tarah chamakne lagte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun pausing his pencil hovering millimeters above the paper
panels.action: Ha-Jun freezes; his pencil lead snaps cleanly as a profound chill runs down his spine.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun freezes; his pencil lead snaps cleanly as a profound chill runs down his spine.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun jam jata hai; jaise hi uski reedh ki haddi mein gahri thandak daudati hai, uski pencil ki lead aasani se toot jaati hai.

panels.shot: the classroom windows rattling violently as sky turns blood red
panels.action: The sky outside instantly turns from clear blue to apocalyptic crimson; glass panes vibrate violently.
panels.prose_en: The sky outside instantly turns from clear blue to apocalyptic crimson; glass panes vibrate violently.
panels.prose_hi: Bahar ka aakash turant saaf neele se sarvanashakari lal rang mein badal jata hai; kaanch ke sheeshe zor se kampan karte han.

panels.shot: students gasping and standing up in panic staring out windows
panels.action: Thirty students leap from their chairs, running to the windows in terrified screams.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: What is happening to the sun?! The sky is burning!!

panels.prose_en: Thirty students leap from their chairs, running to the windows in terrified screams.
panels.prose_hi: Tis chhatra apni kursiyon se kood pade aur bhaybhit hokar chillate hue khidkiyon ki or bhage.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing up slowly, his student uniform billowing in mana draft
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands up from his desk; his navy blazer billows as faint violet sparks dance around his shoes.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands up from his desk; his navy blazer billows as faint violet sparks dance around his shoes.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni mej se khada ho jata hai; uska navy blazer halke baingani rang ki chingariyon ke roop mein uske jooton ke charon or naach raha hai.

panels.shot: min-jae running to ha-jun: 'ha-jun! is this... the void?!'
panels.action: Min-Jae runs over, eyes wide behind his glasses: 'Ha-Jun! Look at the sky! The breach is everywhere!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: This isn't a small gate! The whole sky is cracked!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae runs over, eyes wide behind his glasses: 'Ha-Jun! Look at the sky! The breach is everywhere!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je daudta hai, uski aankhen uske chashme ke peeche chaudi hoti han: 'ha-jun! aasman ki or dekho! ullanghan har jagah hai!'

panels.shot: ha-jun looking out the window seeing a 2-mile dreadnought descending
panels.action: Descending through the crimson clouds right above Saint Mirren University: a colossal 2-mile obsidian dreadnought.
panels.prose_en: Descending through the crimson clouds right above Saint Mirren University: a colossal 2-mile obsidian dreadnought.
panels.prose_hi: Sent miren vishwavidyalaya ke theek upar gahre lal rang ke baadalon ke beech se utarte hue: ek vishal 2 meal ka obsidian drednot.

panels.shot: the classroom ceiling beginning to crumble from sonic pressure
panels.action: Plaster showers down as the engine roar of the alien dreadnought rattles the campus foundation.
panels.prose_en: Plaster showers down as the engine roar of the alien dreadnought rattles the campus foundation.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi alien khunkhar ke engine ki garjana se parisar ki neenv hilti hai, plaster barsne lagta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising his hand deploying a protective ward over the classroom
panels.action: Ha-Jun touches the classroom floor; a glowing golden dome seals the room, insulating all thirty students from the rubble.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Stay inside this circle. No demon can breach this ward.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun touches the classroom floor; a glowing golden dome seals the room, insulating all thirty students from the rubble.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun kaksha ke farsh ko chhuta hai; ek chamakta hua sunhara gumbad kamre ko seal kar deta hai aur sabhi tees chhatron ko malbe se bacha leta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking back at min-jae with calm, resolute eyes
panels.action: Ha-Jun: 'Min-Jae. You're in charge of the class. Keep them calm.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Min-Jae, class ko protect karo. I'm going outside.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun: 'Min-Jae. You're in charge of the class. Keep them calm.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun: 'min-je. aap kaksha ke prabhari han. unhen shant rakhen.'

panels.shot: min-jae nodding with tears of fierce courage in his eyes
panels.action: Min-Jae nods firmly, gripping a steel chair as a makeshift weapon: 'Go, Ha-Jun! Show them who owns this world!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Don't hold back, brother! Give them hell!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae nods firmly, gripping a steel chair as a makeshift weapon: 'Go, Ha-Jun! Show them who owns this world!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne asthayi hathiyar ke roop mein steel ki kursi ko pakadkar dridhta se sir hilaya: 'jao, ha-jun! unhen dikhao ki is duniya ka malik kaun hai!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun vaulting through the shattered window into the red sky
panels.action: Ha-Jun leaps through the window glass, his uniform transforming in mid-air into the majestic robes of the Demon Sovereign.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun leaps through the window glass, his uniform transforming in mid-air into the majestic robes of the Demon Sovereign.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun khidki ke sheeshe se chhalang lagata hai, uski vardi hawa mein rakshas samprabhu ke rajsi vastra mein badal jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun hovering alone between saint mirren and the colossal dreadnought cliffhanger
panels.action: A 17-year-old student hovering in mid-air, facing down a two-mile alien warship to defend his school!
panels.mood: the defense of saint mirren cliffhanger

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: TUM GALAT CAMPUS MEIN AA GAYE HO!!

panels.prose_en: A 17-year-old student hovering in mid-air, facing down a two-mile alien warship to defend his school!.
panels.prose_hi: Ek 17 varshiya chhatra apne school ki raksha ke liye do meal door videshi yudhpot ka samna karte hue hawa mein mandara raha hai!
